name: 2015 livery
description: White forward fuselage with the big outlined 'wizz' wordmark by the door; from the wing aft the fuselage is all magenta, and a straight diagonal of deep blue-violet rises from the belly behind the wing to the crown at the fin, so the tail cone is blue. The fin is magenta at the top and leading edge, blue below a diagonal that climbs to the trailing edge's tip. Magenta engines and sharklets with white 'wizzair.com'.

areas.name: blue-violet diagonal to the tail (straight from the side)

logos.description: The 'wizz' wordmark by the forward door, painted in outline only: big slanted letters drawn as a line, magenta in their upper half turning blue-violet below, white inside; the i's dot a ring under the line, joined to the last z's foot. A logo entry because a title can't be drawn in outline. It covers the stretch the letters were measured over (x 0.133 to 0.255, the letters' feet at y -0.06, their tops at 0.54) on both sides, reading the same way.
'wizzair.com' in white lowercase along the magenta sharklet. Lettering; a logo entry only because titles can't sit on winglets.

titles.style: Bold rounded lowercase over the rear windows on the magenta.
As the fuselage's, on the outboard side of the cowling.
Large white lowercase along the magenta belly under the wing.

notes: Measured on A321neos (2025); A320s/A321ceos wear the same. Wizz Air Malta (9H-) and Wizz Air UK (G-) aircraft wear it unchanged. Where the magenta begins under the wing is hidden in the photos; the belly is only glimpsed (blurred) on approach. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on 9H-WDS (A321neo, side-on): 'wizz' and the aft 'wizzair.com' given measured lengths; the belly title has no photo that shows it clearly enough to measure its length. 2026-11-27: the outlined 'wizz' moved from a title to a logo entry (WZZ/wordmark), because a title is drawn as solid letters and the real wordmark is an outline; checked on 9H-WAO (right side, 2025-11-07).
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation. The 2015 scheme replaced Wizz's earlier white aircraft with a purple fin and magenta 'wizzair.com' titles.
